basic_details.job_title: NIPER-Ahmedabad Project Technical Support III (Medical Device) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Medical Device at NIPER-Ahmedabad has invited applications for one Project Technical Support-III post on an ICMR-funded project, initially for 1 year at ₹28,000 per month plus HRA, as admissible. The essential qualification is a three-year graduate degree in Lifesciences, chemical sciences and allied fields with three-year post-qualification experience in a similar field or PG in a relevant field, or a four-year graduate degree in chemical, mechanical, biomedical, material or engineering. Apply through the Google form on or before 9 December 2026 (Advertisement No. Project/20

content_sections.heading: NIPER-Ahmedabad Project Technical Support-III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research-Ahmedabad (NIPER-Ahmedabad)
Development of Electroactive and Anti-inflammatory Nanomaterial-Reinforced Hyaluronic Acid Hydrogels for Neuroregeneration in Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury (ICMR Project ID: EMDR/SG/16/2026-01-03197)
Initially 1 year/availability of fund; renewals for a maximum additional period of 2 years
₹28,000 per month plus HRA, as admissible; approximate total emoluments ₹36,400 per month
35 years as on the last date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post with one essential qualification, in two alternatives. Three-year graduate degree in Lifesciences, chemical sciences and allied field (biochemistry, biotechnology, biomedical science, chemistry, polymer chemistry, medical device, pharmaceutics, or pharmacology etc.) with three-year post-qualification experience in similar field or PG in relevant field. OR four-year graduate degree chemical/mechanical/biomedical/material/engineering. Desired work experience: handling polymers, monomers, preparing cryogel or hydrogel, basic cell culture, purchase and indenting chemicals, accounting and maintaining project expenditure data, proficient with MS-Excel, MS-Word and PS-PowerPoint. Age: 35 years as on the last date of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is ₹28,000 per month plus HRA, as admissible. The approximate total emoluments are ₹36,400 per month. The engagement is initially for 1 year/availability of fund. Renewals are for a maximum additional period of 2 years, subject to satisfactory performance each year, availability of funds, and co-terminus with the duration of the project. The position is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER-Ahmedabad Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Fill the online form available at the Google form link given in the notice, on or before 09.12.2026. Apply only through the Google form; applications through any other mode will not be entertained. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the further screening process / interview (Online/Offline). Produce all original certificates and relevant documents at the time of the selection process. Attach a copy of the submitted application (proof of application) with the documents during verification. Any further communication is to be made at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that shortlisted candidates will be informed via email regarding the further screening process / interview, which may be online or offline. No interview date is given in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The selected candidate will be engaged purely on a temporary basis and the position is co-terminus with the project.
